messages:
zara_se: Heads-up: Horizon POC ramped to ~25rps, seeing TTFT spikes (200->800ms) and a few 429s during bursts. Demo in 45m. Can we triage quickly?
tom_oncall: Which model/region and any example req_ids?
zara_se: Model=open-llama-1, region=eu-west, req=hz-771. Mix of short headers + long continuations. They enabled prefill=true.
mike_support: Quick log snippet shows kv_cache=MISS and batch_window reported ~120ms when spikes happen.
alexa_eng: Two fast fixes to try on call: 1) set batching.window_ms=10 2) set prefill.tokens=8 (or prefill=false to compare). Also consider routing to burst-eu pool if available.
sarah_finance: If they need burst capacity for the demo we can offer a one-off burst at list_rate *1.4 for the window; need PO.
client_eng: We'll sanitize prompts and run whatever you suggest. Send curl and we'll paste headers.
mike_support: Curl to run:
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"model":"open-llama-1","input":"<sanitized>"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
Look for x-rw-ttft, x-rw-cache-status, x-rw-batch-window-ms.
tom_oncall: Pushing a conservative infra change: reduce batching.max_window_ms to 40 in eu-west for 20m to stabilize.
zara_se: On the call now. Will report back.
(15m later)
zara_se: Result: After setting batching.window_ms=10 and prefill.tokens=8 TTFT stabilized ~160-220ms and 429s stopped. Client requests a 2-hr demo burst, sending to finance.
mike_support: I'll add the reproducer and a short KB on warmup/prefill to support docs.
troubleshooting_done: true
